concerns.text: The idea explicitly specifies stratification quantiles: 'top 20%' and 'bottom 20%' drift bins. The spec replaces these with '[deferred]' ('top [deferred] of drift_score'). The [deferred] convention covers unverified EMPIRICAL values; the 20% cut is a stated design parameter from the source idea, not a measured quantity, so deferring it silently drops an idea-mandated requirement. Restore the 20%/20% quantiles (or justify a different fixed value).
